latest_release.name: super-board v3.1.2
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* 🔒 [security] approval: bind human sign-off to reviewed code by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/23
* 🐛 [fix] setup: restore every card status after any board option rewrite by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/27
* 🐛 [fix] ci: robust Chrome profile cleanup by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/28
* 🐛 [fix] visual: Chrome cleanup works on Python 3.9 by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/29
* 🐛 [fix] upgrade: preserve task state across interrupted upgrades by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/25
* 📝 [docs] pr: explain changed files with review comments by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/26
* 🐛 [fix] github: pause runs when required reads fail by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/24
* 📝 [docs] readme: add YouTube walkthrough card by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/31
* 🐛 [fix] github: show read shapes and stop malformed reads halting the wave by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/33
* [impeccable] canvas-only map with scannable popovers by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/50
* [impeccable] v4.5.2 map: router node, stage popovers, parent badges by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/51
* [super-collect] offline evals + 4 baseline bug fixes by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/53
* [skill-maps] pstack map page + modal dialogs and examples for impeccable by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/52
* 📝 [docs] super-collect: v3.1.2 — document the PR #53 tests, evals and fixes by @EricTechPro in https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/pull/54


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/compare/v3.0.4...v3.1.2
